Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio! 🕯️ Creamy chicken gnocchi soup  Ingredients: 	⁃	2 chicken breast 	⁃	3 carrots, diced 	⁃	2 celery stalks, diced  	⁃	1/2 yellow onion, diced  	⁃	4 garlic cloves 	⁃	2 tbsp all purpose flour 	⁃	3 cups chicken broth 	⁃	3 cups half and half 	⁃	1 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/4 tsp paprika 	⁃	1/2 tsp red chili flakes 	⁃	1/2 tsp thyme 	⁃	1/2 tsp black pepper 	⁃	1 tbsp chicken bullion 	⁃	Parmesan rind 	⁃	16 oz gnocchi 	⁃	1 1/2 cup spinach 	⁃	1 cup Parmesan Instructions: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, then season generously with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and salt. Heat about 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken for 6–8 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside to rest. While the chicken cooks, dice the onion, celery, and carrots, and mince the garlic. Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the same pot. Cook until the onion becomes translucent, then add the minced garlic and cook for another minute. Stir in the flour and cook briefly. Slowly add the chicken broth and half-and-half, stirring to combine. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, red pepper flakes, thyme, and chicken bouillon. Stir well, then add the Parmesan rind. Cover the pot and reduce the heat to low-medium. Simmer for 20–25 minutes, or until the soup has thickened and the vegetables are tender. Remove the Parmesan rind. Dice the cooked chicken and add it to the soup along with the gnocchi, spinach, and grated Parmesan. Stir and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the gnocchi is tender and the spinach has wilted. Ladle into bowls and finish with extra grated Parmesan and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes. Enjoy! 🤎 #soup #soupseason #fallrecipes #autumn #fallvibes

videos.caption: Cowboy Butter Cheeseburger Sliders These Cowboy Butter Cheeseburger Sliders are cheesy, buttery, and packed with flavor! Perfect for an easy dinner, game day, or feeding a crowd! Ingredients For the Sliders 1 lb ground beef ½ yellow onion, diced 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp cowboy butter seasoning, or to taste 1 package sliced provolone cheese ⅓ cup French fried onions 1 package slider buns (12 count) 2 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp Dijon mustard For the Cowboy Butter Topping 2 tbsp butter, melted 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped ½ tsp cowboy butter seasoning Directions 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Add the ground beef and diced onion to a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, until the meat is fully cooked and the onion is tender. Drain any excess grease. 3. Stir in the Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and cowboy butter seasoning. 4. Add 4 slices of provolone cheese and the French fried onions to the beef mixture. Cover the skillet with a lid and allow the cheese to melt. Stir everything together until creamy and combined. 5. Slice the entire package of slider buns in half horizontally. Place the bottom half in a baking dish. 6. In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise and Dijon mustard. Spread the mixture evenly over the bottom buns. 7. Add a layer of provolone cheese over the buns, followed by the cheeseburger mixture. Top with the remaining provolone cheese. 8. Place the top half of the slider buns over the cheese. 9. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, fresh parsley, and ½ teaspoon cowboy butter seasoning. Brush generously over the tops of the sliders. 10. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, or until the sliders are heated through and the cheese is completely melted. 11. Remove the foil and, if desired, bake for another 2–3 minutes to lightly toast the tops. 12. Slice into individual sliders and serve warm. Enjoy! #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #sliders

Another new high protein pasta recipe for you. This one is a spin on broccoli sausage pasta that swaps fatty pork sausage for lean ground chicken + a sweet and spicy sauce. Recipe is below or if you want the (always free) printable version head over to my blog. Cook 8 oz orecchiette or small pasta shells in a pot of boiling salted water until just shy of al dente. Reserve about 1 cup of pasta water and drain the rest. Slice 1 bunch (about 8 oz) of broccolini or broccoli florets into thin bite-size pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a nonstick pan then add the broccolini. Cook for 3-4 minutes, tossing a few times, until nicely roasted all over. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Add a pound of ground chicken breast to the same pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden brown on one side before breaking apart with a spatula. (I like to leave the chicken in larger pieces, maybe somewhere between a pea and a marble, instead of completely crumbling.) Once the chicken is fully cooked, add a sauce made with 2 tablespoons each of tomato paste, chopped Calabrian chili peppers (or swap for more tomato paste), and balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon honey, 2 cubes of frozen crushed garlic (or 2 cloves fresh), 1 teaspoon of Italian seasoning, and 1/3 cup water. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken before adding the broccolini back to the pan. Toss them together before adding the cooked pasta, 2 oz grated parmesan, the zest of 1 lemon, and about 1/2 cup of the reserved pasta water. Toss together until a smooth and creamy sauce forms, using more pasta water if needed. Finish with salt/pepper, a squeeze of lemon juice, extra grated parm, and chili flakes or more Calabrian chili peppers if you dig spice. Makes 4 servings (about 280g or 10 oz) with 41g protein, 53g carbs, 13g fat, and 5g fiber each. #highproteinmeals #groundchicken #chickenpasta #broccolini
